names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 4 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Βασίλειος του Μιρώζ και Ιωάσαφ του Σνετνογκόρσκ οι Οσιομάρτυρες», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 4 марта ст. ст., name page 1034, «Иоасаф Снетогорский, Псковский, прмч.», with the rank words left off. The day's own line declines the name. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form. The two halves of the page spell the house two ways: the day's line declines Снетногорского, with an extra н, and the name link gives Снетогорский. The link's spelling is the one stored and the line's is named here.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 4 марта ст. ст. — «Прп. Иоасафа Снетногорского, Псковского (1299)»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Βασίλειος του Μιρώζ και Ιωάσαφ του Σνετνογκόρσκ οι Οσιομάρτυρες»

attestations.note: One page holds the two of them and heads each «(; - 1299)». Its whole notice is three sentences: they lived in the thirteenth century in the region of Pskov in Russia; Basil was abbot of the monastery of the Transfiguration of the Saviour of Mirozh and Joasaph abbot of the monastery of the Nativity of the Theotokos of Mount Snatna; and they were martyred in the year 1299, when the Germans attacked Pskov and the monasteries of the region. Because the line names both, each is kept as a folder of his own. The day's line spells his house «του Σνετνογκόρσκ» and the body «του όρους Σνάτνα»; the display name follows the day's line. The page gives no place of birth, no year for it, no manner of death, no relic, no distich and no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Οι Άγιοι μαρτύρησαν κατά το έτος 1299 μ.Χ., όταν οι Γερμανοί επιτέθηκαν εναντίων του Πσκωφ και των μοναστηριών της περιοχής», and the page heads him «(; - 1299)». It gives no year of birth, only the thirteenth century for the two of them.
